title: 228cm Snowy Pre-Lit Christmas Tree $89.50 (Was $179) Delivered / C&C / in-Store @ BIG W
body:
Deal: 228cm Snowy Pre-Lit Christmas Tree $89.50 (Was $179) Delivered / C&C / in-Store @ BIG W

[Sale La Vie] Thanks! Just edited it. $89.50 (50% off original price)
[QuickToThePointless] $10 on clearance if you can hold out til January
[Disabled-User] Russian orthodox Christmas says Yes! (So does motor finance wizard).
[essent1al] Thanks I think I got the last one in WA (Riverton)
[Sale La Vie] Probs better for those who have kids or pets, or can’t get access to a real fresh cut tree
[Satchimo] Because it will get sunburned if you put it up outside. It's plastic, it may even melt.
[QuickToThePointless] And presents could also get stolen if they can be seen/accessed from street front… Christmas trees are best off inside
[ilikedeals] Looks nice.
If you want a 1.8m tree - try Bunnings (pre-lit) for $59-$69
[RADICALIST] Is it common to discount a Christmas tree before Christmas? These should be hot items
[QuickToThePointless] if you leave the LED transformer unattended, they well might be 🔥
[Sale La Vie] Not sure if common, but it was promoted as a “Black Friday preview”. Still, agree that it’s rare to see them discounted beforehand
[calneideck] Pre-lit is all well and good until a single globe goes out :/
[OnlyFans] dont do it, white crap goes everywhere! I've experienced all the white stuff.
[Satchimo] There ares cures for mild dandruff in the supermarket aisles or dermatologists treat it if it's really pad.
